<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">

      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>

    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="7" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".28"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="url(#bg)"/>

  <!-- Background profile card -->
  <g opacity=".92">
    <rect x="18" y="66" width="354" height="625" rx="24" fill="#000000" opacity=".18"/>

    <text x="38" y="454" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="26px" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">Maya, 27</text>
    <text x="38" y="480" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="normal" fill="#FFFFFF">Graphic designer • 3 km away</text>

    <text x="38" y="542" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="normal" fill="#FFFFFF">Loves live music, weekend markets</text>
    <text x="38" y="564" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="normal" fill="#FFFFFF">and finding the best coffee spots.</text>
    <circle cx="342" cy="631" r="22" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".9"/>
    <polyline points="333,631 339,637 351,624" fill="none" stroke="#96E063" stroke-width="3"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Darkened overlay -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#000000" opacity=".48"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="19" font-family="SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
    <line x1="334" y1="14" x2="338" y2="14" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="342" y1="14" x2="346" y2="14" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>

    <line x1="298" y1="17" x2="303" y2="12" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="303" y1="12" x2="308" y2="17" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6"/>

    <rect x="364" y="11" width="14" height="6" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="382" y="12" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Tinder brand header -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="34,73 42,55 49,66 57,50 62,73 54,84 42,84" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="72" y="79" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="26px" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">tinder</text>
    <circle cx="352" cy="70" r="18" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".2"/>
    <line x1="346" y1="64" x2="358" y2="76" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="358" y1="64" x2="346" y2="76" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <rect x="8" y="523" width="374" height="310" rx="30" fill="#000000" opacity=".35"/>

  <rect x="177" y="529" width="36" height="4" rx="2" fill="#D9D9D9"/>

  <text x="195" y="605" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="25px" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Like life, but better.</text>

  <!-- Feature row -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="55" cy="674" r="22" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <polygon points="55,658 59,670 71,670 61,677 65,689 55,682 45,689 49,677 39,670 51,670" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

    <text x="55" y="724" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="normal" fill="#939393">Likes</text>

    <circle cx="130" cy="674" r="22" fill="#4396F7"/>

    <text x="205" y="724" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="normal" fill="#939393">Picks</text>

    <circle cx="280" cy="674" r="22" fill="#96E063"/>
    <polyline points="280,658 280,674 290,681" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3"/>

    <text x="280" y="710" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Rewind</text>
    <text x="280" y="724" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="normal" fill="#939393">Swipes</text>
  </g>

  <!-- CTA buttons -->
  <g>
    <rect x="36" y="744" width="318" height="44" rx="22" fill="url(#bg)"/>
    <text x="195" y="772" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">UPGRADE TO GOLD</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="36" y="794" width="318" height="25" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="195" y="811" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="normal" fill="#939393">Maybe later</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation, visible beneath sheet -->
  <rect x="0" y="821" width="390" height="23" fill="#000000" opacity=".7"/>
  <g opacity=".7">
    <polygon points="43,828 52,820 61,828 61,837 55,837 55,831 49,831 49,837 43,837" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="52" y="843" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="9px" font-weight="normal" fill="#FFFFFF">Discover</text>
    <circle cx="130" cy="828" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="130" y1="822" x2="130" y2="834" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="130" y="843" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="9px" font-weight="normal" fill="#FFFFFF">Likes</text>
    <polygon points="200,823 205,830 213,830 207,835 209,842 200,838 191,842 193,835 187,830 195,830" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="200" y="843" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="9px" font-weight="normal" fill="#FFFFFF">Boost</text>

    <ellipse cx="303" cy="837" rx="10" ry="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="303" y="843" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="9px" font-weight="normal" fill="#FFFFFF">Profile</text>
  </g>
